01. About Me

Hello! I'm Akhilesh Gajula, an AWS Cloud & DevOps Engineer based in Hyderabad, India. I specialize in designing, deploying, and automating cloud infrastructure that's reliable, scalable, and secure.

With 4 years of professional experience at CoAkcess Private Limited, I've worked across the full DevOps lifecycle — from infrastructure provisioning and CI/CD pipeline setup to monitoring, security hardening, and cost optimization on AWS.

I'm passionate about cloud-native architectures, infrastructure-as-code, and serverless computing. I actively document my learning and share resources to help others break into the cloud engineering space.

Currently pursuing AWS Solutions Architect – Associate certification and exploring Kubernetes and advanced Terraform patterns.

04. Projects
🏗️

3-Tier Highly Available AWS Architecture

Production-grade infrastructure with public/private subnets, Application Load Balancer, EC2 Auto Scaling Groups across multiple AZs, RDS Multi-AZ with read replica, and automated failover. Includes CloudWatch alarms, SNS notifications, and security group chaining for zero-trust segmentation.

VPCALBEC2 ASG RDS Multi-AZCloudWatchTerraform
⚡

Serverless Microservices Platform

End-to-end serverless backend using AWS Amplify for hosting, API Gateway (REST + WebSocket), Lambda functions for business logic, DynamoDB for data persistence, and Cognito for authentication. Includes automated deployment via GitHub Actions and full CloudWatch observability.

AmplifyAPI GatewayLambda DynamoDBCognitoGitHub Actions
🔁

DevOps CI/CD Pipeline with Blue-Green Deployment

Full CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins, Docker, and AWS CodeDeploy for Java microservices. Implements blue-green deployment strategy to Elastic Beanstalk with zero-downtime releases. Includes automated testing gates, Slack notifications, and rollback triggers based on CloudWatch health metrics.

JenkinsDockerCodeDeploy Elastic BeanstalkMavenCloudWatch
